rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０６７＿００８Are you really sure...?￥You could have taken a much￥easier road, you know...
＊Natsuno＊＠０６７＿００９I'll give it my all, so I'll￥never be a burden to you!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Natsuno Depart　－

＊Natsuno＊＠０６７＿０２４Was this really the right call?￥Even now, I worry whether I'm￥really qualified for this...＝＠０６７＿０２５But there's no use doubting now!￥All I can do is give it￥everything I've got.＝＠０６７＿０２６I might cause you some trouble,￥but... I'll do the best I can!

＊Natsuno＊＠０６８＿００１Just standing here with you￥right now would be enough to￥make me happy...＝＠０６８＿００３and now we're actually going to￥Elan? I can't believe it!＝＠０６８＿００４Thank you... for choosing me.＝＠０６８＿００５I swear I'll live up to￥your expectations!

＊Natsuno＊＠０６８＿００２Just being chosen by you would￥be enough to make me happy...＝＠０６８＿００３and now we're actually going to￥Elan? I can't believe it!＝＠０６８＿００４Thank you... for choosing me.＝＠０６８＿００５I swear I'll live up to￥your expectations!
